findings.title: Cleanup targets the literal alias instead of the created providers
findings.body: The cleanup callback uses `get("alias")` rather than the created provider's alias (`idp-alias-*`). As a result, none of the providers created by this test are removed; the same mistake is repeated at line 425. These identity providers, including those linked to an organization, remain in the shared test realm and can contaminate later tests or cause order-dependent failures.
